description: Add two new report types to ReportService: 'ckcc-od' (CKCC OD Field Report) and 'ckcc-npa-krm' (CKCC NPA Accounts under KRM OTS Scheme Field Report). These are completely separate from the existing CKCC OD-2 renewal report. Each report queries visit_reports joined with visit_ckcc_details and visit_ots_details respectively, filtered by relevant report_type, and returns the standard report shape. Also add dedicated routes and controller methods for separate printable views and dedicated PDF exports for each.
steps: 1. Add two new entries to ReportService::TYPES array: 'ckcc-od' => ['label' => 'CKCC OD Field Report', 'description' => 'CKCC OD case field verification reports with supervisor details'] and 'ckcc-npa-krm' => ['label' => 'CKCC NPA / KRM OTS Field Report', 'description' => 'NPA accounts under KRM OTS Scheme field verification reports'].

2. Add two new private static methods in ReportService.php: ckccOdReport(array $filters) and ckccNpaKrmReport(array $filters). ckccOdReport queries visit_reports vr JOIN visit_ckcc_details cd ON cd.visit_report_id = vr.id, with columns: visit_date, agent_name, bcbf_code (from users table join), customer_name, loan_account_number, branch_name, outstanding_amount, overdue_amount, renewal_due_date, days_remaining, kyc_status, eligible_for_renewal. ckccNpaKrmReport queries visit_reports vr JOIN visit_ots_details od ON od.visit_report_id = vr.id, with columns: visit_date, agent_name, bcbf_code, customer_name, loan_account_number, branch_name, npa_date, outstanding_amount, scheme, total_settlement_amount, borrower_payable_amount, deposit_received, approval_status, customer_response.
3. Add 'ckcc-od' and 'ckcc-npa-krm' cases to the match() in ReportService::build().

4. Register new web routes in app/routes/web.php: GET /reports/ckcc-od/print/{id} and GET /reports/ckcc-npa-krm/print/{id} for individual printable report views. The existing /reports/{type} and /reports/{type}/export routes already handle the list views and exports through ReportController.

5. Create a new controller method in ReportController (or a new CkccReportController) for the printable individual report view. This renders a dedicated print-friendly view for each report type, separate from the existing visit show page. Include Supervisor name and BCBF Code in the header.

6. Create view files: views/reports/ckcc-od-print.php and views/reports/ckcc-npa-krm-print.php. These are A4-optimized print layouts. No Borrower Signature section. Include Supervisor name and BCBF Code in the header. Use Bootstrap 5 responsive grid. Follow the banking field-report style of the existing visit PDF.

7. Add schema additions (as a separate migration SQL file at schema-migrations/001-ckcc-od-npa-reports.sql or appended to schema.sql with clear comments): No new tables needed - the existing visit_ckcc_details and visit_ots_details tables already have all required fields. Only need to ensure the bcbf_code is accessible via user joins.
8. Update views/reports/index.php to include the two new report cards in the grid with appropriate icons.
acceptance_criteria: ReportService::build('ckcc-od', $filters) returns a valid report shape
ReportService::build('ckcc-npa-krm', $filters) returns a valid report shape
Routes /reports/ckcc-od and /reports/ckcc-npa-krm are accessible through the existing report controller
Dedicated printable views exist for both report types
Supervisor name and BCBF Code appear in report headers
No Borrower Signature appears in either report
Running php -l on all new/modified files passes with no syntax errors
verification: Run `find /projects/bankmityra3 -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \; 2>&1 | grep -i 'error'` and confirm zero errors
Confirm new report types exist in ReportService::TYPES with `grep -n 'ckcc-od\|ckcc-npa-krm' /projects/bankmityra3/app/Services/ReportService.php`
findings: Used visit_reports.supervisor_name and visit_reports.supervisor_employee_id for the supervisor/BCBF fields since the users table has no reports_to FK. The visit_reports table already stores supervisor details per visit. Created a new layouts/print.php for A4-optimized printable views that works across all screen sizes. Both report types correctly filter by report_type ENUM values: ckcc_renewal for OD reports and ots for NPA/KRM reports.
